'''Mustag Olus''' was a [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Mustag Olus was a [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] who operated in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. After the conclusion of the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] pushed Olus to construct an army of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and rise up against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the [[Kol Huro system/Legends|Kol Huro system]]. Sidious hoped to both test and further weaken the strength of both the Republic and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="TEA" /> 

In what became known as the [[Kol Huro Unrest]], the absence of a [[Republic Military/Legends|centralized military]] forced the intervention of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in order to destroy Olus's growing army, which they succeeded in doing.<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="Rogue Planet">''[[Rogue Planet]]''</ref>
